---
title: "Projects & Initiatives"
---

Dr.Miles-Richardson leads transformative work focused on **environmental justice**, **health equity**, and **workforce diversity** in public health. Below are selected major initiatives.  

---

## Novartis Center of Excellence on Climate & Environment  
**Director — Morehouse School of Medicine** *(2022–Present)*  
Promoting environmental and respiratory health equity through community engagement and applied research.

---

## TRIUMPH Informatics Training Consortium  
**Subaward PI** *(2022–2025)*  
Funded by NIH/CDC — expanding **informatics, data analytics, and project management training** for underrepresented MPH students.

---

## Racial & Ethnic Approaches to Community Health (REACH US)  
**Co-Investigator** *(2007–2013)*  
Addressed disparities in **breast & cervical cancer screening** among African American women in the Southeastern U.S.

---

## National Leadership in Public Health Education  
- **President**, Council on Education for Public Health  
- **President**, Association of Accredited Public Health Programs  
Leading national accreditation and workforce policy standards to assure quality **public health education**.

---

## Environmental Health & Toxicology  
Research spanning more than 25 years evaluates **chemical exposures**, **endocrine disruptors**, and **community vulnerability** to environmental hazards.

> Dr. Miles-Richardson’s work consistently centers those communities most affected by **structural inequities** and environmental injustice. Please contact for further information.
